newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Oct property sale up on speculation - Salomon.
newsitem.headline: HK Oct property sale up on speculation - Salomon.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Tuesday the sharp rise in property transations in Hong Kong in October was due to a combination of bulk buying in the office sector, an increase in speculative buying in the residential market and an upsurge in mainland Chinese buying.

"The large differential increase of 35 percent in registered units and the substantial 66 percent increase in the value of sale and purchase agreements registered ... suggests a number of large sales of entire buildings, probably office buildings," the investment bank said in a press release.
Salomon added that there had been no notable publicity of large deals in October, which it believed pointed to a large increase in mainland buying.
It said the fact that 30 percent of applications for a recent property development were registered by companies suggested a rise in speculative buying in the residential market for the month.
